{{Quote|If the collective memory of the Selkath fails to recall the Empire's last demonstration of power, then new lessons will be visited upon them.|Darth Xarion|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] was '''invaded''' around [[3625 BBY]]<ref name="TOR_updates" /> by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[third Galactic War]], in order to seize the [[Waterworld/Legends|waterworld's]] abundant supply of [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]]<ref name="Dead" /> and to counteract the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath's]] "disrespect" after a meager trade deal.<ref name="Intelligence" />
